widgets_values:
## 8-direction animated sheet
Load a **front-facing** sprite and pick an action. The sprite is rotated to S, SE, E, NE, N (W/SW/NW are mirrored), each facing is animated with the same action, frames are snapped to the sprite's grid and palette, and everything is packed into one sheet: **one row per direction** (clockwise from S, or RPG order), one column per frame, plus an Aseprite JSON.
Runtime ≈ 5 × an HQ animation run (needs the anim models). Set `directions` to 4 for S/E/N/W only.
Turn the character in the image to a {direction}. Keep exactly the same character design, outfit, colors, proportions, size and pixel art style. Full body, centered, {background}.
